description: Source-type validation: both data sources independently tested against first-tradable-day sector-adjusted returns.
finding: Each source independently demonstrates directional validity at or above the 53-55% literature bar. Tweets show larger sentiment-scaled reactions (70.8bps vs 18.3bps) and slightly higher impact IC; news provides far greater volume (19.9k vs hundreds of events). The combination justifies the two-source architecture.
note: Weighting sources differently was considered and shelved: both hit rates are comparable, so a fixed blend performs equivalently.
